decisions.decision: Claude implemented directly instead of dispatching Codex

decisions.decision: G1 fixed with two mechanisms, not the one the ticket described
decisions.rationale: Demoting the download button alone just promotes the upload button to default, and upload needs a native multipart submit so form.requestSubmit() rejects it. So: runtime type='button' on the download button PLUS a data-default-action keydown router.

decisions.decision: Download button keeps type='submit' in markup; JS demotes it at runtime
decisions.rationale: formaction only works on submit buttons, so a markup-level type='button' would break the <noscript> download — the mirror of the G3 defect being fixed.

decisions.decision: Three file-clean commits instead of the requested one-per-defect
decisions.rationale: The four front-end defects overlap within the same files (deck-sync.ts has G1+G3, DeckAnalysis.cshtml has G1+G2). A per-defect split needs partial-line staging that cannot produce valid intermediate commits.

decisions.decision: DeckPrimer.cshtml's missing data-cache-key left to batch A
decisions.rationale: Batch A already fixes that exact line; fixing it in batch G too would collide. Resolved by convergence — the G4 sweep is now fully closed.
